raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

torch 2.14 adds the `torch.bcomplex32` dtype. A pickled tensor carries its dtype as a GLOBAL opcode, so with the pinned torch 2.14.1 `safe_pickle_loads` refuses any payload that holds a bcomplex32 tensor:

```
RuntimeError: Blocked unsafe global (torch.bcomplex32) during pickle deserialization
```

Every other dtype the installed torch exposes is already in `SafeUnpickler.ALLOWED_GLOBALS`; this one was missed when the pin moved.

## Modifications

- Add `("torch", "bcomplex32")` to `SafeUnpickler.ALLOWED_GLOBALS` in `python/sglang/srt/utils/common.py`.
- Add `test_allowlist_covers_torch_dtypes_and_tensor_classes` to `test/registered/unit/utils/test_safe_unpickler.py`. It diffs the allowlist against the dtypes, storage classes and tensor classes the installed torch exposes, so the next dtype torch introduces fails a CPU unit test instead of refusing a payload at runtime.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model or kernel code changes.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed.
- [ ] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed.
- [ ] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a reviewer.

Verified locally with torch 2.14.1+cpu: `test/registered/unit/utils/test_safe_unpickler.py` passes with the change (5 tests), and the new test fails without the allowlist line, reporting exactly `[('torch', 'bcomplex32')]` missing. A `torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.bcomplex32)` payload round-trips through `MultiprocessingSerializer` with the change.

files.patch:
@@ -6,7 +6,11 @@
 
 import torch
 
-from sglang.srt.utils.common import MultiprocessingSerializer, safe_pickle_loads
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import (
+    MultiprocessingSerializer,
+    SafeUnpickler,
+    safe_pickle_loads,
+)
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -57,6 +61,29 @@ def test_round_trips_safe_standard_library_types(self):
         self.assertEqual(restored.index, value.index)
         self.assertEqual(restored.parser("11"), 11)
 
+    def test_allowlist_covers_torch_dtypes_and_tensor_classes(self):
+        # A pickled tensor carries its dtype and tensor class as GLOBAL
+        # opcodes, so every dtype the installed torch exposes must be listed
+        # or a payload using it is refused.
+        torch_globals = {
+            ("torch", name)
+            for name in dir(torch)
+            if isinstance(getattr(torch, name), torch.dtype)
+        }
+        torch_globals.update(
+            (cls.__module__, cls.__name__)
+            for cls in (*torch._storage_classes, *torch._tensor_classes)
+        )
+
+        missing = sorted(torch_globals - SafeUnpickler.ALLOWED_GLOBALS)
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            missing,
+            [],
+            f"torch {torch.__version__} globals missing from "
+            f"SafeUnpickler.ALLOWED_GLOBALS: {missing}",
+        )
+
     def test_round_trips_tensor_payload(self):
         value = [("weight", torch.arange(6).reshape(2, 3))]
